The '''Second Battle of the Maw''' was a circumstantial battle fought in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. The Imperial forces of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] were chasing the escaped [[Sun Crusher]] piloted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Kyp Durron]] and deserting [[Maw Installation]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Qwi Xux]]. At their point of leaving [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], a cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]], they encountered the mercenary force of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] that had been gathered to protect the planet by its administrator, [[Moruth Doole]]. The fleet of mismatched ships was chasing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] piloted by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], which was fleeing into the Maw. Neither fleet was aware of the other's existence, and when the Star Destroyers emerged from the Maw, the undisciplined Kessel fleet attacked out of self-preservation.

==Prelude to the battle==
Shortly before the battle, Qwi Xux had rescued the captives Han Solo and Kyp Durron from their cells in the Maw Installation, and released Chewbacca from his slave duties repairing TIE fighters. They had escaped in the Sun Crusher, a virtually indestructible vessel of unparalleled destructive capability. Unwilling to let the Sun Crusher escape her control, Admiral Daala ordered the Star Destroyer ''[[Hydra]]'' to block off the only safe exit from the Maw. However, due to the [[Quantum-crystalline armor]] of the small vessel, Han Solo piloted the ship directly through the bridge of the ''Hydra'', causing it to lose all control and fall into one of the Maw's black holes, killing all aboard, although 40 TIE's from ''Hydra'' were saved. Outraged, Daala ordered a full pursuit of the Sun Crusher.<ref name="JS" />

Meanwhile, on the moon orbiting Kessel, Luke Skywalker and Lando Calrissian were investigating the disappearance of Han Solo and Chewbacca during their diplomatic mission fro the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Moruth Doole, the ''de facto'' administrator of the Kessel facility, had in fact ordered them to be shot them down, and imprisoned them in the spice mines. Unbeknownst to Skywalker and Calrissian, the pair had escaped with Kyp into the Maw. However, when inspecting the defensive fleet Doole had developed on the [[Garrison Moon]], the pair found the ''Millennium Falcon'' and realized what had happened. They stole the ship and fled. Unfortunately, the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|computer]] was disabled, forcing them to flee into the Maw. Fearing [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] retribution, Doole ordered a full pursuit of the craft. However, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] didn't know the formations for when the whole fleet was mobilized and they converged into a disorderly mass of ships.<ref name="JS" />

==The Battle==
As Daala's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] arrived out of the Maw Cluster, they ran headlong into the Kessel fleet.<ref name="JS" /> Some of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] ships peeled sideways to escape back to Kessel, but others panicked and opened fire. Daala ordered her ships to raise their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and open fire, speculating that it may be a trap that the New Republic had set for her.

The battle itself was swift and violent. The mercenaries were unorganized and unprepared for any large-scale assault. The highly trained and drilled Imperial troops laid waste to the many various ships in the opposing fleet; many fled the system just before and soon after engagement, fearing the power of an organized Star Destroyer fleet.<ref name="JS" />

The clash of these two forces granted both pursuees time to join up and escape undetected.

As the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] envoys went to go to hyperspace, three [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]] lined up to blast the Star Destroyer [[Basilisk (Star Destroyer)|''Basilisk'']], while all the Star Destroyers launched their [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="JS" /> The Kessel fleet's [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] exploded under the combined fire of the ''[[Manticore]]'' and the ''Basilisk'' and some of its flaming hulk hit the ''Basilisk'', causing its bottom to buckle and burn, although the damage wasn't critical.

Most of the Kessel fleet was eventually defeated by Daala and the few surviving ships fled into hyperspace.<ref name="Champions of the Force">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref> The Maw fleet suffered far less casualties; three TIE Fighter squadrons were lost and the ''Basilisk'' was damaged and had to be linked to the ''[[Gorgon]]''{{'s}} navicomputer before it could leave the Kessel system.<ref name="JS" />

==Aftermath==
Following the near eradication of the Kessel fleet, Daala launched her fleet into hyperspace. She eventually sought refuge in the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]] as a staging base to launch her [[Daala campaign|guerrilla strikes]] against the New Republic. The first of these would be the [[Attack on Dantooine (Galactic Civil War)|Dantooine Massacre]].<ref name="DA" />

The ''Millennium Falcon'' and Sun Crusher escaped in tandem (the ''Falcon'' using coordinates from the Sun Crusher's navicomputer and informed the New Republic of the situation in the Maw Installation, appealing to send an investigatory force.<ref name="JS" /> They dispatched some ships to assess the situation on Kessel, gain access to the Installation, and free the Wookiee slaves captive there.<ref name="Champions of the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
There is a minor variance in how much of the Kessel fleet was said to have been destroyed during the battle. In [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kratas]] says that two thirds of it was destroyed, but in ''Champions of the Force'', [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] claims that it was 90%. Kratas' figure is probably the more likely of the two to be correct, as he was present during the battle, whereas Jade wasn't.
